item.isekai_mahou.twilight_heart.desc: The Herald's last heartbeat, where light and shadow touch.
item.isekai_mahou.twilight_heart.use: Hold use to absorb it: +60 max mana and +10% spell power, forever (once per adventurer).
message.isekai_mahou.twilight_heart.used: Twilight now beats inside you. Your mana and power have grown forever.
message.isekai_mahou.twilight_heart.alre: You already carry the twilight within you.
message.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.vic: The Twilight Herald has fallen. Light and shadow go their separate ways once more... for now.
command.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.spawn_fail: The boss could not be summoned here.
announce.isekai_mahou.abyss_sovereign.in: Another soul comes to kneel before the Abyss.
announce.isekai_mahou.abyss_sovereign.ph: You lit a candle at the bottom of the well. I will snuff it out.
THE ABYSS HAS NO BOTTOM. AND I AM THE ABYSS!
announce.isekai_mahou.abyss_sovereign.de: The Abyss Sovereign is defeated. The crown of horns shatters...
boss.isekai_mahou.seraph.subtitle: Guardian of the Six Wings
announce.isekai_mahou.seraph.intro: No mortal climbs the stairway of heaven without being judged.
announce.isekai_mahou.seraph.phase2: Behold the light that knows no shadow!
announce.isekai_mahou.seraph.phase3: Let every heaven sing your sentence!
announce.isekai_mahou.seraph.defeated: The Seraph lowers its wings. The sanctuary falls silent.
boss.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.subtit: The One Who Heralds the End
boss.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.domain: Here the sun never rises, and the night never ends
boss.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.final_: Light and shadow part ways once more
announce.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.in: You who were summoned from another world... have you come to see the end of this one?
announce.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.ph: Light and shadow are a single blade. Feel both edges!
Then see the world as I do... from inside MY domain!
announce.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.la: So... this is how the day ends...
command.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.spawned_tr: Boss summoned in Trial mode (arena of radius %2$s around the summon point): %1$s
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.grounded: %s landed, exhausted — this is your chance to strike!
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.chain: Chains! Step off the marked line before the throw.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.tide: Shadow Tide! It is too tall to jump: stand in one of the green gaps.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.tide_: Another tide, with rotated gaps! As soon as the first wave passes you, run to the new green zone.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.eclip: Eclipse! Tendrils burst from the violet circles — keep moving.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.erupt: Abyssal Eruption! Jump over the shadow wave as it passes.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.beams: Wheels of Light! Hug the boss: the green core is safe and you can hit it.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.cross: Cross Judgment! Get out of the light strips — and if a second, rotated cross follows, move again.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.praye: The Seraph landed to pray! Hit it hard to interrupt the heal.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.nova: Twilight Nova! Jump both rings, one of light and one of shadow.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.ruptu: Twilight Rupture! GOLDEN tiles explode first, then VIOLET ones — switch tiles at the right time.
Twilight Rupture! VIOLET tiles explode first, then GOLDEN ones — switch tiles at the right time.
message.isekai_mahou.bosses_b.hint.domai: Domain! On every pulse, stand inside a GREEN zone — they rotate after each pulse.
The domain collapsed — the Herald is exhausted!
